messages:
Jin (Marketing): Heads up team  new blog + benchmark goes live in ~60m. We need: 1) one-sentence exec quote, 2) press kit link, 3) triage channel ready. @Priya @Tess @Nina please.
Priya (Comms): I'll draft the exec quote now. Prefer something future-facing, not technical. Also want to stagger outreach by region (NA/EU/APAC).
Omar (Product): Updated the methods appendix with reproducibility notes. Link: https://internal.redwood.ai/optimize/appendix. No customer data used.
Tess (Legal): Confirmed: "No customer data was used" must appear in blog. Also use the approved product name casing: "Redwood Optimize". Keep claims conservative re: competitors.
Jin (Marketing): Noted. Press kit (zip + assets) uploading to S3 now; will paste link here when ready. Avoid publishing raw notebook snippets on social.
press-monitor-bot: Monitoring enabled. Will post any pickup > 2.5k reach into #press-clips.
Priya (Comms): Draft exec quote options (pick one or edit):
> Option A: "Redwood Optimize marks a major step in making inference both faster and more economical for production teams."
> Option B: "Our goal with Redwood Optimize is to help builders reduce inference cost without sacrificing user experience."
Jin (Marketing): Leaning Option B. Shorter and customer-centric.
Tess (Legal): Slight tweak: change "builders" to "engineering teams". Also add a claused line: "See appendix for methodology." Approving Option B with that change.
Priya (Comms): Final quote set: "Our goal with Redwood Optimize is to help engineering teams reduce inference cost without sacrificing user experience. See appendix for methodology." Will be used for pitches and press release.
Jin (Marketing): S3 press kit link: https://s3.internal.redwood.ai/optimize-presskit-1812404321.zip
Priya (Comms): Outreach plan: DM 8 priority reporters in NA now, EU batch at T+20m, APAC T+45m (local mornings). No broad social until I give the green.
Nina (Support): Triage channel ready: #optimize-press-triage. I put the quick FAQ and token/latency talking points in that channel.
Jin (Marketing): Deploy bot, please start the scheduled publish at T+60.
deploy-bot: Publish job queued: blog-optimize-v1 -> scheduled for 60m from now.
Priya (Comms): Also prepping an embargo-free FAQ for reporters who ask for numbers. Keep top-level numbers but refer detailed configs to appendix.
Omar (Product): If reporters ask about hardware or quantization, say we used a mix of supported variants and point them to the appendix config table.
Tess (Legal): One more: do not promise SLA or availability for Dedicated in the post. That’s a sales conversation.
Priya (Comms): Got it. Will not mention Dedicated or pricing specifics. Pitch will offer an engineer for short calls.
press-monitor-bot: First ping: TechByte showed interest; emailed requesting comment. Priya to reply with suggested quote + offer of engineer.
Jin (Marketing): Social cadence: T+15 teaser, T+30 blog link, T+90 follow-up deep-dive thread if pickup looks good. Priya has final say on exact copy.
Priya (Comms): I'll hold social until NA batch is sent. If any reporter publishes ahead, we will adjust timing and post immediately.
Nina (Support): Support on standby; added a short escalation playbook to the triage channel. If negative technical reports come in, tag @eng-runtime and @eng-oncall.
Priya (Comms): One more logistics note: APAC reporter list includes a Mandarin-speaking contact. Jin, can we provide localized images/captions? 
Jin (Marketing): Yes, I asked localization to standby. Will upload translated assets to the press kit if needed.
Priya (Comms): Ok team. I'll paste outreach responses here. Keep this thread clean for status updates only.
